meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 HEAD 和已发布的 npm 版本做对比，按发布层列出所有尚未发布的改动，并说明每处改动的真实内容与影响，最后给出每层的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等关键词，或想了解哪些改动还没发版时触发。它不提问、不寒暄，直接输出分析。

say.text: 列出 HEAD 和已发布 npm 版本之间还没发布的改动
say.note: 直接输出按发布层分组的改动清单

say.text: 帮我看看 oh-my-opencode 该发 patch 还是 minor
say.note: 给出各发布层和整体的版本号建议

say.text: 把没发布的改动整理成分层 changelog
say.note: 按 feat/fix/refactor 分类并标注影响层

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer, describes what really changed, and recommends a patch/minor/major bump per layer plus one overall bump.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed" or "whats new". It starts the analysis immediately, with no questions or preamble.

say_en.text: List the unpublished changes between HEAD and the published npm versions
say_en.note: Outputs a change list grouped by layer

say_en.text: Should oh-my-opencode get a patch or a minor bump?
Turn the unpublished changes into a changelog by release layer
